newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound interbank rates fall in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound interbank rates fall in liquid market.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell on Wednesday in a liquid market to between 7-1/2 and 8-1/2 percent from 8-1/8 and 8-1/2 percent on Tuesday, bankers said.
"Banks are squaring their position before the weekend," said one banker who dealt at a rate of 7 percent. Thursday is a public holiday to mark Prophet Mohammed's birthday.
One-week trading rates were also slightly lower at between 7-7/8 and 8-3/8 percent compared to eight and 8-1/2 percent, they added.
